body: Daughter prefers deliveries before 2 PM — she meets the vendor at the side door.
O2 concentrator running louder than usual last visit. Flagged vendor for filter check on next route.
Discharge window is tight Saturday morning. Confirm hospital bed pickup is scheduled after family leaves.
Family asked for a commode closer to the recliner — consider second unit if mobility worsens.
Wandering risk increased — ensure bed alarm pad stays plugged in after vendor visits.
Dialysis days are Tue/Thu/Sat — avoid scheduling DME deliveries those mornings if possible.
Stroke recovery — left-side weakness. All mobility aids should stay on patient's right when staging equipment.
Discharge Monday 8 AM. Pre-stage pickup for wheelchair and concentrator Sunday evening if vendor can.
